summary: Optimize tool execution latency for redup regix and planfile sdk

delivery.outcome: Accelerate quality gate and queue lifecycle performance by switching redup to fast incremental diff scanning, regix to diff-scoped review, and eliminating redundant CLI subprocess readbacks in PlanfileClient SDK.
nonGoals: Modify protected merge policies or release gates
Remove full-suite publication verification in CI

architecture.decision: Add redup_gate_command using --changed-only --incremental in git repos, use regix review --workdir <project> HEAD local with config detection, and default KORU_PLANFILE_SDK_VERIFY to disabled.
architecture.rollback: Revert the material ticket commit cleanly.

validation.evidence: Fast redup gate scanning, regix review on diff, and disabled parity default tests pass.
Governance check passes with 0 errors, 0 warnings.
